programs.title: Happened Schnirch
programs.desc: Brno, the night of May 30-31, 1945. Gerta Schnirch (Barbora Váchová), the daughter of a Nazi and a Czech mother, together with her several-month-old child, is - like almost all Germans - expelled from the city.The exhausting procession, marked by violence and humiliation, later called the death march, ends near the border with Austria.From the temporary camp, Gerta goes to work in the Moravian countryside.She manages to save her own life and that of her daughter.After five years he returns to Brno.No one is waiting for her in the city, but she still can't leave it.She becomes entangled in a vortex of further turbulent changes.A film adaptation of Kateřina Tučková's debut novel, "The Expulsion of Greta Schnirch", touching on the difficult topic of Czech and German guilt, revenge, forgiveness and national identity.

programs.title: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore
programs.desc: The powerful and cruel magician Gellert Grindelwald (Mads Mikkelsen) intends to take over both the world of wizards and ordinary muggles.Professor Albus Dumbledore (Jude Law) knows about his plans and wants to stop him, but due to their blood pact, he cannot fight him.So he entrusts this task to magizoologist Newt Scamander (Eddie Redmayne).The wizard creates a team that includes his assistant Bunty (Victoria Yeates), brother Theseus (Callum Turner), defensive charms teacher Eulalie Hicks (Jessica Williams), a relative of the murdered Leta Lestrange - Yusuf Kama (William Nadylam), and Muggle baker Jacob Kowalski (Dan Fogler).The last member of the team wants to free his beloved, Queenie (Alison Sudol), from Grindelwald's power.During a dangerous mission, they will all come face to face with known and unknown animals and will fight with increasingly numerous followers of the cruel magician.An adaptation of another famous novel by J.K.Rowling.

programs.title: Night Of The Zoopocalypse
programs.desc: In the middle of the night, a meteorite falls on the zoo.Thanks to him, some of the inhabitants turn into neon, jelly-like creatures with suspicious properties, and the entire zoo is thrown into chaos.The clever wolf Gracie and the haughty puma Dan, who have been out of each other's way until now, decide to put aside their personal grudges to save the animals.Together with a group of daredevils, including Frida the capybara, Felix the baboon, Ash the nervous ostrich, Xavier the lemur and the charming Hippo, they create a crazy rescue team.The Polish language version was attended by, among others:Magdalena Boczarska, Marcin Piętowski and Mateusz Banasiuk.

programs.title: La grazia
programs.desc: The President of Italy (Toni Servillo) is at the end of his term.In six months, his political and social role will come to an end.At this time, the head of state faces moral dilemmas caused by the euthanasia regulations and the issue of pardoning two life sentences.Every decision will expose the politician to criticism, but it is up to him to decide which crime deserves forgiveness: an act of mercy or murder.Bending under the weight of responsibility, the statesman tries to buy time.At the same time, he struggles with personal problems.Despite the passage of 40 years, he still has not forgiven his deceased wife's betrayal, and he cannot find the way to his daughter (Anna Ferzetti).Ultimately, however, it proves that even if you know yourself perfectly, you can make a decision that will surprise everyone and bring inner freedom.

programs.title: A Working Man
programs.desc: Former Royal Marines Levon Cade (Jason Statham) leaves his military career to lead the life of a construction worker.His plans for a peaceful retirement as a foreman are disrupted by the news of the abduction of his boss's (Michael Pena) teenage daughter, Jenny Garcia (Arianna Rivas).The girl became a victim of the Russian mafia led by Kharchenko (Andrei Kaminsky).Levon initially refuses to get involved in the case, but after consulting with his old friend, he decides to take up arms again.He uses his experience and contacts to save the hostage.The mission turns into a real massacre.The film's script was co-written by Sylwester Stallone.

programs.title: The Martian
programs.desc: A mission to the Red Planet is interrupted by a sandstorm.A team of astronauts evacuates to Earth, leaving one of the expedition members, Mark Watney (Matt Damon), on the surface of Mars, believing he is dead.After some time, the seriously injured astronaut regains consciousness.He realizes that his air and food supplies will soon be exhausted.He also cannot count on a rescue mission because he was presumed dead.Despite this, he tries to survive in difficult conditions and notify the inhabitants of Earth that he is alive and waiting for help.Ridley Scott's film is nominated for an Oscar in seven categories, including:as the best film and for the leading role of Matt Damon.Director Ridley Scott, the creator of such cult sci-fi films as "Blade Runner" and the Alien series, was a candidate for the Academy Award four times.
